Definition: from a derivative of G3605; smell (the sense):--smelling.
BiblicalUsage: Smelling is one sense among many in Paul's picture of the body. If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be, and if the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be? Every part is placed by God as it pleased Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the body of Christ needs every member: if the whole body were smelling, where would the hearing be?
